races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict: KATTY has shown the benefit of her debut effort in 2 starts since, the form of her third at the Curragh last time having been boosted by the winner, and she could be ready to get off the mark. races.verdict: Aidan O'Brien probably holds the aces here with BENGAL TIGER taken to put his experience to good use having chased home a next-time-out improver over C&D 3 weeks ago. races.verdict: HELVIC DREAM was better than ever when winning a listed handicap hurdle at Listowel recently and having slipped to a career-low mark in this sphere, Noel Meade's former Group 1 winner gets the verdict to follow up back on the level. races.verdict: The market will no doubt be a decent guide as to what's expected but LION ROSE SIVOLA is selected to make a successful return/hurdling debut having found just one too strong in a couple of soft ground bumpers last season. Dan Skelton has unleashed plenty of runners this week and debutant Skibidirizz is put forward as the main danger, with standard-setter Mwabani taken to fill out third on his reappearance. LION ROSE SIVOLA (FR) SKIBIDIRIZZ (IRE) MWABANI (FR)

races.display_title: Co-Op Superstores Handicap Chase
races.verdict: BIRDIE OR BUST wasn’t at her best back over hurdles when last seen but should be suited by the drop in trip and looks worth siding with for last year’s winning yard, currently in a rich vein of form. Cappa Hill belatedly matched the pick of his hurdles form at Listowel last time and rates the main danger if building on that, while Jasko des Dames is also respected in an open handicap. BIRDIE OR BUST (IRE) CAPPA HILL (IRE) JASKO DES DAMES (FR)
